decisions.reason: The mandatory answer-layer decision does not change how the existing question set is reviewed, removed, or documented.
The global-perspective integration and country-specific guidance remain valid unchanged; the answer-layer structure is owned by the separate source Requirement.
The decision about layers for question answers does not alter the AI chapter's mandatory status, covered material, or length guidance.
The chapter remains about questions candidates can ask interviewers; the source does not necessarily require those prompts to use the book's answer-layer format.
The pre-interview checklist's audience, content, international guidance, and length policy are unaffected by the answer-layer decision.
The required answer layers do not change the authoritative editing artifact or the suggestion-mode question-removal workflow.
The chapter's subject and length guidance remain unchanged; the cross-cutting structure of answers is represented by the source Requirement.
The answer-layer decision concerns manuscript question answers and does not alter companion-resource types or their finished-product delivery format.
The chapter's first-time-leader content focus and length policy remain unchanged; the universal answer format is already captured by the source Requirement.
Requiring two mandatory answer layers does not modify the established 110,000-word ceiling or the recorded existing-edition word count.
The manuscript answer-layer structure does not change the completeness or specificity required for companion templates.
The answer-layer decision does not alter the video-script deliverable or the editorial team's recording responsibility.
